caseName: Children's Hosp. L. A. v. N.L.
caseNameFull: CHILDREN'S HOSPITAL LOS ANGELES v. N.L., a Minor, By and Through his Guardian ad Litem, Jacqueline ARCE.

opinions.text: Motion of California Hospital Association, et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit denied.
